# glinet_switch_button (Resource)

Sets the function of the side switch of the router (`switch-button.get_config` and `switch-button.set_config`). The switch turns the function on in one position and off in the other. **Warning:** after a change, the position of the switch can turn a VPN tunnel, a Wi-Fi network, AdGuard Home or another function on or off. The provider always sends `sync` `false`, as the web UI does when the user does not accept to sync the function with the current switch position. What the router does with the function at the time of the write is not known. The functions depend on the router model, the firmware and the configuration: before each write, the provider reads them with `switch-button.get_funcs`, and when `function` or `sub_function` is not available, create and update fail and do not write to the router. Only a router with a switch (`hardware_feature.switch_button` of `system.get_info` is not empty) has this setting: on other routers, create and update fail and do not write to the router. The router has one switch configuration, so use one instance of this resource. The write is from the web UI code of firmware 4.8.3 and was not tested on a router. Destroy removes the resource from the Terraform state and does not change the router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The switch turns the guest Wi-Fi on and off.
resource "glinet_switch_button" "this" {
  function     = "wifi"
  sub_function = "guest_wifi"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `function` (String) Function of the switch (`func` in the router API): `none` or a function of `switch-button.get_funcs`. Firmware 4.8.3 has functions such as `adguardhome`, `led`, `repeater`, `tor`, `wifi` and `vpn`, and firmware 4.7.0 has `openvpn` and `wireguard` in place of `vpn`. The web UI does not let the user select a function that is not installed, such as AdGuard Home or Tor; the router can list it.

### Optional

- `sub_function` (String) Sub-function of `function` (`sub_func` in the router API), for example `main_wifi` or `guest_wifi` for `wifi`, or the ID of a VPN tunnel as a string for `vpn`. Required when the function has sub-functions in `switch-button.get_funcs`, and cannot be set when it has none or when `function` is `none`. A VPN tunnel ID can change when the VPN tunnels change; then the next plan shows a difference or the apply fails.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `switch_button`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is always "switch_button".
terraform import glinet_switch_button.this switch_button
```
